title: Great holders
text: Great holders. Didnt realize how much easier it would make for taco nights. I always have 2 tacos on my plate flat..and after I fill them they overlap and begin to fall apart. Having them in the holder is so much easier to fill and hold in place until I want to pick it up..should have gotten them long time ago lol.. Very easy to clean and store.
